books.title: A Queer Dharma: Yoga and Meditations for Liberation
books.author: Jacoby Ballard
books.description: Jacoby Ballard reads the Brahma Viharas, the heart teachings shared by yoga and Buddhism, through a queer lens, with practices for working with anger, self-compassion, lovingkindness and grounding. Drawing on years of teaching queer and trans yoga classes, in schools and in prisons, he also looks at how mainstream yoga meets questions of justice, capitalism and cultural appropriation.
